[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-kp[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]sase monitor — long-running commands as first-class agent family [/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]         [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]members[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Agents can hand a slow command (`just check-full`, a CI wait, `sase[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bead work`) to `sase monitor start` and be killed cleanly, while [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]the command keeps running as a live, first-class monitor member of [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]their agent family — with streaming output, live runtime, custom [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]start/stop statuses, a timeout, and an optional follow-up agent [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]that resumes the same workspace and conversation when the command [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]finishes.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]12[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]agent artifact scan.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
